review_context: Controlled refresh of checked read-only UI demo wrapper fixtures after adding Rust source-hash and snapshot-coherence gates.
finding_title: Checked UI wrapper refresh is separate from generated-run artifact promotion.
finding_summary: Refreshing demo-ui-review-data-bundle.json source hashes and demo-rust-fixture-manifest-report.json inventory can make checked frontend evidence hash-current, but it does not regenerate or semantically promote the underlying QA detail reports from a run root.
observable_context: The read-only UI bundle and fixture manifest were stale: the source-hash gate found 19 UI detail hash mismatches and the snapshot-coherence gate found 2 manifest drift entries.
The new refresh command updates only demo-ui-review-data-bundle.json and demo-rust-fixture-manifest-report.json.
The refresh reported old bundle id ui_review_data_bundle_c2a7116a9c69 and new bundle id ui_review_data_bundle_06f7b6a1952e.
The refresh updated 20 source hashes, left 1 unchanged, found 0 missing sources, and verified manifest_status=passed, source_hash_gate_status=passed, and snapshot_gate_status=passed.
A full generated-run-root promotion and sanitizer remains a separate future slice because semantic QA detail reports can carry run-root-sensitive refs and cross-report IDs.
observable_decision_logic: Wrapper evidence bindings should be refreshed only by an explicit write command, not by a read-only checker.
A wrapper refresh can repair stale source hashes and manifest inventory without mutating semantic QA detail reports.
The UI bundle/confidence-summary relationship can create cross-report dependency loops, so semantic report regeneration should be handled by a later allowlisted run-root promotion flow.
Passing wrapper Rust gates proves current local JSON evidence binding, not budget correctness, production readiness, Lake admission, or learning.
solution_path: Add refresh-ui-demo-fixtures with an explicit --write-fixtures guard.
Recompute UI bundle detail source hashes from resolved checked demo files.
Regenerate demo-rust-fixture-manifest-report.json by running the Rust fixture manifest scanner with the checked manifest as the output path.
Update the bundle's rust_fixture_manifest source hash after manifest regeneration.
Verify the refreshed wrappers with the Rust UI bundle source-hash gate and Rust fixture snapshot-coherence gate.
Add tests covering write-guard behavior, temp fixture refresh, and checked fixture gate verification.
applies_when: A checked frontend demo wrapper needs to reflect current local JSON detail files.
A source-hash or manifest snapshot gate fails because wrapper evidence is stale.
A repo needs to distinguish evidence wrapper freshness from semantic regeneration of source QA reports.
does_not_apply_when: A workflow needs to copy and sanitize generated run-root artifacts into checked demo fixtures.
The underlying semantic QA detail reports are themselves stale or incorrect.
An owner-approved runtime artifact registry already manages the current evidence binding.
danger_if_misapplied: If wrapper refresh is treated as full generated-run promotion, DAD or reviewers may overtrust stale semantic QA reports. If the wrapper refresh is skipped, the UI can display local JSON evidence with stale hashes.
suggested_actions: DAD should classify wrapper freshness separately from semantic detail-report freshness.
Future work should add an allowlisted generated-run-root promotion and sanitizer command.
Exception Lake design should keep wrapper drift events distinct from budget, matter-linking, or learning-loop semantic defects.
reviewer_notes: This record contains synthetic fixture and local artifact references only.
It records observable evidence, decision logic, fix refs, and test refs without hidden chain-of-thought.
red_team_notes: Do not let refreshed wrapper hashes imply production readiness or budget correctness.
Do not regenerate semantic QA reports silently from a wrapper refresh.
Do not promote local candidate report schemas to Semantic Substrate canon from this repo.
